ARTICLE XII

BASIC SCHEDULES AND RATES OF PAY

<fcel>12-1<fcel>Classification of Staff:<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-1 Regular Teachers: All regular teachers plus librarians, therapists, nurses and instructional assistants come under the salary schedule and are assigned to 38 weeks of service.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-2 More Than 38-week Teachers: Those assigned to contracts for longer terms are paid by formula or prorated salaries based on the salary schedule.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-3 Reduced Load (Part-time Teachers): Those teachers employed for a time period less than 1.000 of a full time teacher shall be assigned a contract on which the pay shall be prorated from the regular salary schedule listed in Appendix A.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-4 Summer School Teachers: See Appendix C.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-5 Reserve Teachers: See Appendix D.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-6 Creative Play Teachers: See Appendix E.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-7 Adventure Club Teachers: See Appendix F.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-8 Parent-Child Center Teachers: See Appendix G.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-9 Adult Basic/Continuing Education (AB/CE) Teachers: See Appendix H.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-10 Hourly Rate LD: See Appendix J.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-11 Off-Campus Teachers: See Appendix J.<nl><ecel><fcel>12-1-12 Hourly Rate LEP Teachers: See Appendix J.<nl><fcel>12-2<fcel>Salary Schedule: The wages and salaries reflected in Appendix A, attached hereto, shall be a part of the Agreement for the 1985-86 and 1986-87 school years.<nl><fcel>12-3<fcel>Extra-curricular Salary Schedules: The ages and salaries reflected in the extra-curricular schedule, marked Appendix B, shall be a part of this Agreement for the 1985-86 and 1986-87 school years.<nl><fcel>12-4<fcel>Status of Salary Schedule: Upon expiration of this Agreement, the salary schedules contained herein shall have no force and effect and shall not be construed as a part of a teacher's continuing contract.<nl>
